description: POST /oauth/token with valid client credentials (JSON body)

probes.description: issued token must be persisted for the client
probes.sql: SELECT access_token FROM api_clients WHERE client_id = 'demo-portal'

probes.description: stored expiry must be in the future (~1h)
probes.sql: SELECT expires_at > now() AND expires_at <= now() + interval '2 hours' FROM api_clients WHERE client_id = 'demo-portal'
